one_line: Three rival kings of the Pratihara, Pala and Rashtrakuta courts during the Tripartite campaigns for Kannauj.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, athletic but not overly muscular, medium height
appearance.face: oval face, wheatish North Indian complexion, straight nose, sharp jawline, neatly trimmed black moustache, calm but intense eyes with a thoughtful, assessing default expression
appearance.hair: long straight black hair pulled back and tied at the nape into a compact low knot, front section parted slightly off-center with two short side locks framing the temples; no crown, only a simple dark red cloth headband wrapped flat around the forehead with a small gold disc at the center
appearance.costume: era-accurate aristocratic warrior attire: a knee-length off‑white cotton angarkha-style tunic crossing left over right, secured with cloth ties, worn over fitted dusky-red churidar trousers; a heavy forest‑green woolen shawl draped from left shoulder diagonally across the torso and around the back, its borders embroidered with fine geometric gold thread; a narrow leather kamarband belt in dark brown at the waist; simple leather boots in dark brown rising just above the ankle; minimal jewellery limited to a thin gold neck torc close to the collarbone and a pair of small gold stud earrings; overall look practical, courtly and travel-ready, avoiding heavy regalia so he can plausibly stand for any of the three kings while remaining region-and-era grounded.
appearance.signature: a straight single-edged steel sword of early medieval Indian type with a modest disc pommel and simple crossguard, sheathed at his left hip in a dark brown leather scabbard with two small gold fittings, his right hand often resting lightly on the hilt as a gesture of poised authority rather than aggression

ref_desc: An athletic king in an off‑white angarkha, dusky‑red churidar, forest‑green embroidered shawl, dark brown boots and belt, long black hair in a low knot with red headband, gold studs and neck torc, bearing a sheathed steel sword with dark brown scabbard and gold fittings.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of an early medieval Indian king: mid-30s, athletic build, oval wheatish face, sharp jaw, calm intense eyes, neatly trimmed black moustache, long straight black hair tied in a compact low knot with a dark red cloth headband and small gold disc at the center, two short side locks framing the temples. He wears a knee-length off-white angarkha tunic crossing left over right, fitted dusky-red churidar trousers, and a forest-green woolen shawl with fine gold-embroidered geometric borders draped from his left shoulder across the torso and around the back. A narrow dark brown leather belt sits at his waist and simple dark brown leather boots reach just above the ankle. Jewellery is minimal: a thin gold neck torc and small gold stud earrings. At his left hip hangs a straight single-edged steel sword in a dark brown leather scabbard with modest gold fittings, his right hand resting lightly on the hilt. Show him from multiple angles in consistent colors—off-white, forest green, dusky red, dark brown and gold—so his face, hairstyle, clothing and sword can be redrawn identically in different scenes of royal campaigns around Kannauj.
